Olive & Ember — Fine Dining Restaurant

Seasonal, fire-kissed cuisine served in the heart of Millbrook. Join us for an evening of warmth, flavor, and unforgettable company.

Reserve a Table

Our Story

Founded in 2014 by Chef Marco Ferrante, Olive & Ember began as a small hearth-side table serving neighbors and friends. Today, we remain devoted to the same philosophy: honest ingredients, open flame, and generous hospitality.

Every dish passes through our wood-fired hearth, the beating heart of our dining room, where olive wood embers lend a smoky depth you won't find anywhere else in the valley.

Menu

A seasonal selection, refreshed each month with the best the Hudson Valley has to offer.

Starters

  • Charred Octopus$18
  • Burrata & Fig$14
  • Ember-Roasted Beets$12
  • Wild Mushroom Soup$11

Mains

  • Hearth-Fired Ribeye$42
  • Olive Oil Poached Halibut$34
  • Herb Roasted Chicken$28
  • Wild Mushroom Risotto$24

Desserts

  • Olive Oil Cake$10
  • Smoked Chocolate Tart$12
  • Affogato$8
  • Seasonal Sorbet$7

Gallery

A glimpse of the dishes and moments that fill our dining room each evening.

Reservations

Book your table online, or call us at (845) 555-0192. We recommend reserving at least two days in advance for weekend dining.
